It gives me immense pleasure in welcoming you , on behalf of NIPER Guwahati fraternity, on my assuming charge as its Director. NIPER, Guwahati is the only national pharma education institute for the entire North Eastern Region of our country. It was established in 2008 to provide high quality pharma education and research with focus on exploitation of natural and synthetic products of the region for drug discovery and development. At present, NIPER offers post graduate and doctoral research programmes in pharmacology/ toxicology, pharmaceutical practices and biotechnology. All of you are aware that the NIPER system in India has already demonstrated its unique strengths in offering quality pharmaceutical education in general and in integrated management of infectious diseases in particular.
